hostilenetworks.gui.mode.training.desc2: come from a Data Center in this pack
hostilenetworks.trivia.abyssal_maw: The Abyssal Maw lurks in the deepest trenches and swallows anything that strays into its light.
hostilenetworks.trivia.aluminum_ore: Aluminum is light, strong and the most common metal in the earth's crust.
hostilenetworks.trivia.ancient_debris: Ancient debris survives lava and fire, and refines into netherite.
hostilenetworks.trivia.ars_magica_guardi: Each of the ten guardians embodies one magical affinity, and each guards a relic of it.
hostilenetworks.trivia.boron_ore: Boron soaks up neutrons, so reactors use it to keep their fuel in check.
hostilenetworks.trivia.brainy_zombie: Angry Zombies keep enough of their brains to hold a grudge.
hostilenetworks.trivia.celestine_ore: Celestine shards carry signals through Nodeworks networks.
hostilenetworks.trivia.chimerite_ore: Chimerite shifts its color with the light, and mages prize it for that changeability.
hostilenetworks.trivia.chromium_ore: Chromium gives stainless steel its shine and its resistance to rust.
hostilenetworks.trivia.cinnabar_ore: Cinnabar is the ore of quicksilver, the alchemist's favorite metal.
hostilenetworks.trivia.coal_ore: Coal is ancient plant matter pressed into fuel over millions of years.
hostilenetworks.trivia.copper_ore: Copper carries current better than almost any other common metal.
hostilenetworks.trivia.cyclops: A cyclops herds sheep in its cave, and it does not take kindly to visitors.
hostilenetworks.trivia.dark_ore: Dark Gems hum with a faint, unsettling energy that EvilCraft feeds on.
hostilenetworks.trivia.demon: A demon only answers a witch's summons, and it rarely leaves willingly.
hostilenetworks.trivia.diamond_ore: Diamond is pure carbon, crushed into the hardest natural material there is.
hostilenetworks.trivia.dimensional_ore: Dimensional shards hold a sliver of space folded in on itself.
hostilenetworks.trivia.emerald_ore: Emeralds are the coin villagers trust above all others.
hostilenetworks.trivia.fire_dragon: Fire dragons nest in scorched caves and roosts, and their blood and hearts are the heart of dragonsteel forging.
hostilenetworks.trivia.gold_ore: Gold never rusts or tarnishes, which is why it has been prized for thousands of years.
hostilenetworks.trivia.hydra: Cut one head off a hydra and two more grow back, unless you burn the stump.
hostilenetworks.trivia.ice_dragon: Ice dragons freeze everything they breathe on, and they guard the coldest peaks of the world.
hostilenetworks.trivia.iesnium_ore: Iesnium is a pale metal from the Nether that Occultism's spirits value.
hostilenetworks.trivia.inferium_ore: Inferium is the first step on Mystical Agriculture's long road to growing resources.
hostilenetworks.trivia.iridium_ore: Iridium is one of the densest and most corrosion-resistant elements known.
hostilenetworks.trivia.iron_ore: Iron is the backbone of nearly every machine, rail and tool you will ever build.
hostilenetworks.trivia.lapis_ore: Lapis lazuli was once ground into the blue pigment painters valued above gold.
hostilenetworks.trivia.lead_ore: Lead is dense enough to stop radiation, which makes it a reactor builder's friend.
hostilenetworks.trivia.lightning_dragon: Lightning dragons call storms down on their enemies and nest in the high badlands.
hostilenetworks.trivia.lunar_parasite: Lunar Parasites burrow into anything that lands on the Moon, villagers included.
hostilenetworks.trivia.mutant_creeper: A Mutant Creeper charges up and leaps before it blows, and it can survive its own blast.
hostilenetworks.trivia.mutant_enderman: A Mutant Enderman hurls blocks with its four arms and teleports its prey around.
hostilenetworks.trivia.mutant_skeleton: A Mutant Skeleton's bones are large enough to wear as armor.
hostilenetworks.trivia.mutant_zombie: A Mutant Zombie slams the ground hard enough to throw you off your feet.
hostilenetworks.trivia.nether_quartz_ore: Nether quartz grows in the Nether's rock and is the start of most electronics.
hostilenetworks.trivia.nickel_ore: Nickel keeps steel from rusting and gives superalloys their strength under heat.
hostilenetworks.trivia.niobium_ore: Niobium turns superconducting when cold, and LTX Industries builds on that.
hostilenetworks.trivia.piglin_brute: Piglin Brutes guard bastion treasure and cannot be bribed with gold.
hostilenetworks.trivia.pillager: Pillagers raid villages for emeralds, and the vexes their allies summon fight alongside them.
hostilenetworks.trivia.platinum_ore: Platinum resists nearly every acid and tarnish, making it a coveted catalyst metal.
hostilenetworks.trivia.prosperity_ore: Prosperity shards are what turn a plain seed into a magical one.
hostilenetworks.trivia.ravager: Ravagers lead the charge in a raid and flatten crops in their path.
hostilenetworks.trivia.redstone_ore: Redstone dust carries a signal through any circuit you can dream up.
hostilenetworks.trivia.sapphire_ore: Sapphires form deep in cold mountains, the same places ice dragons like to nest.
hostilenetworks.trivia.sea_serpent: Sea serpents roam the open ocean and can capsize a boat with one sweep of their tail.
hostilenetworks.trivia.silver_ore: Silver conducts heat and electricity better than any other metal.
hostilenetworks.trivia.star_crawler_boss: The Star Crawler Mother guards her brood deep under the lunar surface.
hostilenetworks.trivia.sunstone_ore: Sunstone stores the heat of the Nether and gives it back to fire spells.
hostilenetworks.trivia.thunder_king: The Thunder King commands the storm itself, and his royal armor still crackles with it.
hostilenetworks.trivia.tin_ore: Tin alloys readily with copper to make bronze, one of the oldest worked metals.
hostilenetworks.trivia.titanium_ore: Titanium is as strong as steel at nearly half the weight.
hostilenetworks.trivia.topaz_ore: Topaz is the stone Ars Magica casters lean on for their earliest spells.
hostilenetworks.trivia.troll: Trolls turn to stone in sunlight, so they only come out to hunt at night.
hostilenetworks.trivia.uraninite_ore: Uraninite is the ore uranium is refined from, and it is faintly radioactive.
hostilenetworks.trivia.uranium_ore: Uranium packs more energy into a single ingot than a mountain of coal.
hostilenetworks.trivia.vinteum_ore: Vinteum dust is the raw stuff of magical energy in Ars Magica.
hostilenetworks.trivia.xychorium_ore_blu: Blue xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
hostilenetworks.trivia.xychorium_ore_dar: Dark xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
hostilenetworks.trivia.xychorium_ore_gre: Green xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
hostilenetworks.trivia.xychorium_ore_lig: Light xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
hostilenetworks.trivia.xychorium_ore_red: Red xychorium crystals store energy in their lattice, the basis of XyCraft's machines.
